#!/bin/sh
set -e
umask 077

BASE=/var/lib/local-https
ARCHIVE=$BASE/archive
CURRENT=$BASE/current
CERT=$CURRENT/tls.crt
LOCK=/run/lock/local-cert-renew.lock
RENEW_BEFORE=604800
VALID_DAYS=30

exec 9>"$LOCK"
/usr/bin/flock 9

if [ "$1" != "--force" ] && [ -r "$CERT" ] && /usr/bin/openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SERIAL=$(/usr/bin/openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')
    NOT_AFTER=$(/usr/bin/openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')
    printf 'certificate valid beyond renewal window; serial=%s not_after=%s\n' "$SERIAL" "$NOT_AFTER"
    exit 0
fi

NODE_IP=$(cat /etc/local-https/node-ip)
NODE_NAME=$(cat /etc/local-https/node-name)
WORK=$(mktemp -d "$ARCHIVE/.new.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
CFG=$WORK/openssl.cnf

{
    printf '%s\n' '[req]'
    printf '%s\n' 'prompt = no'
    printf '%s\n' 'distinguished_name = dn'
    printf '%s\n' 'x509_extensions = v3_req'
    printf '%s\n' '[dn]'
    printf 'CN = %s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
    printf '%s\n' '[v3_req]'
    printf '%s\n' 'basicConstraints = critical,CA:FALSE'
    printf '%s\n' 'keyUsage = critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment'
    printf '%s\n' 'extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth'
    printf '%s\n' 'subjectAltName = @alt_names'
    printf '%s\n' '[alt_names]'
    printf 'DNS.1 = %s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
    printf 'IP.1 = %s\n' "$NODE_IP"
} > "$CFG"

/usr/bin/openssl req -new -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
    -config "$CFG" -keyout "$WORK/tls.key" -out "$WORK/tls.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
/usr/bin/openssl verify -CAfile "$WORK/tls.crt" "$WORK/tls.crt" >/dev/null
chmod 0644 "$WORK/tls.crt"
chmod 0640 "$WORK/tls.key"
chown root:nogroup "$WORK/tls.crt" "$WORK/tls.key"
rm -f "$CFG"
chmod 0750 "$WORK"
chown root:nogroup "$WORK"

STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$
FINAL=$ARCHIVE/$STAMP
mv "$WORK" "$FINAL"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
LINK_TMP=$BASE/.current.$$
ln -s "$FINAL" "$LINK_TMP"
mv -Tf "$LINK_TMP" "$CURRENT"

SERIAL=$(/usr/bin/openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT/tls.crt" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')
NOT_AFTER=$(/usr/bin/openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT/tls.crt" -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')
logger -t local-cert-renew "activated certificate serial=$SERIAL not_after=$NOT_AFTER"
printf 'rotated serial=%s not_after=%s\n' "$SERIAL" "$NOT_AFTER"

sudo /bin/sh -n /usr/local/sbin/local-cert-renew

#!/usr/bin/python3
from __future__ import print_function

import os
import ssl
import sys
from BaseHTTPServer import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from SocketServer import ThreadingMixIn

CERT = "/var/lib/local-https/current/tls.crt"
KEY = "/var/lib/local-https/current/tls.key"
BIND = "0.0.0.0"
PORT = 8443


class HealthHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path != "/health":
            body = b"not found\n"
            self.send_response(404)
        else:
            body = b"node1 HTTPS OK\n"
            self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return


class ReloadingHTTPServer(ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

    def __init__(self, address, handler):
        self._context = None
        self._cert_state = None
        HTTPServer.__init__(self, address, handler)
        self._refresh_context(True)

    def _state(self):
        cert_stat = os.stat(CERT)
        key_stat = os.stat(KEY)
        return (
            cert_stat.st_dev, cert_stat.st_ino, cert_stat.st_mtime, cert_stat.st_size,
            key_stat.st_dev, key_stat.st_ino, key_stat.st_mtime, key_stat.st_size,
        )

    def _refresh_context(self, force=False):
        state = self._state()
        if not force and state == self._cert_state:
            return
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_SSLv23)
        context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2 | ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
        context.load_cert_chain(CERT, KEY)
        self._context = context
        self._cert_state = state
        sys.stdout.write("loaded certificate from {0}\n".format(os.path.realpath(CERT)))
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def get_request(self):
        raw_socket, client_address = self.socket.accept()
        try:
            self._refresh_context()
            tls_socket = self._context.wrap_socket(raw_socket, server_side=True)
            return tls_socket, client_address
        except Exception:
            raw_socket.close()
            raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ReloadingHTTPServer((BIND, PORT), HealthHandler)
    print("serving HTTPS on {0}:{1}".format(BIND, PORT))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    server.serve_forever()
